item.title: Projects
item.description: Open-source tools, research artifacts, and utilities from our research and day-to-day security work. Actively maintained projects first. AI × Security# The current focus: putting LLMs and coding agents to work on security problems — and keeping what leaves the device under control. ida-pro-mcp — AI-powered reverse engineering assistant that bridges IDA Pro with language models through MCP. Python burp-ollama — Burp Suite extension providing AI-powered security testing using local Ollama models. Kotlin burp-mcp — MCP server exposing Burp Suite’s REST API as tools for AI assistants. Python daedalus — Detonation, analysis & experimentation architecture for Linux containers and sandboxing. Python — writeup → ollama-forge — pull models from Hugging Face, convert them, add adapters, run them in Ollama. Python LLM Agent Infrastructure# manifold — chain multiple LLM proxy services into a single transparent pipeline. Python — writeup → local-splitter — MCP-compatible outbound shim that cuts cloud token usage by running a local model as triage in front of a frontier model. Python — writeup → llm-redactor — privacy-preserving shim that removes, masks, or transforms sensitive content before it leaves the device. Python — writeup → resilient-write / resilient-read — MCP servers giving coding agents a fault-tolerant write surface and safe chunked reads of very large files. Python — writeup → hivemind — OS-inspired scheduler for concurrent LLM coding agents. Python gen-pilot — context-aware generation planning and deferred document rendering for LLM coding agents. Python Reverse Engineering & Mobile Security# reFlutter — Flutter reverse engineering framework. Python — related writeup → hermes-dec — decompiler and disassembler for React Native Hermes bytecode. Python MEDUZA — a more or less universal SSL unpinning tool for iOS. Python ssl-kill-switch2 — blackbox tool to disable certificate validation, including pinning, on iOS and macOS. Objective-C Clutch — fast iOS executable dumper. Objective-C APKProxyHelper — patches APKs for proxy use. Python APK-Downloader — download APKs from the Play Store. Python Research Artifacts# Code accompanying peer-reviewed work and courses.
